measurementNotes.readyMs: performance.now observed after readiness polling; not exact cover-hide timestamp
measurementNotes.resources: Recorded ResourceTiming entries only; default browser buffer can truncate. Sum is a subtotal, not all bytes.
measurementNotes.cache: New browser contexts for cold; same contexts reload after clearing cookies for warm. HTTP cache preserved; server sends no Cache-Control, matching formal baseline.
measurementNotes.heap: CDP measured JS heap only; renderer RGBA values are estimates, not total process/GPU memory.
measurementNotes.workload: Two guests, 50ms native logical KeyboardEvents, mixed play/result/rematch; summary is whole measurement window.
